name: Pedra lascada marcando a fíbula
description: Uma única raspada curta e seca de pedra lascada marcando a fíbula de um babuíno.
prompt: One quick, dry scoring stroke: the sharp edge of a chipped stone drags across a dry baboon fibula, leaving a small notch. Close-miked realistic Foley, crisp gritty texture, immediate clean stop. Only one stroke. No separate impact, repeated scraping, reverb, ambience, voices, or music.
